cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
s=Path('src/md4c.c').read_text()
# hook before switch any type>=9 abort with input logged by harness? use fuzzer harness global
s=s.replace('#include <string.h>','#include <string.h>
extern void bad_start_hook(int type);')
s=s.replace('static int
md_start_new_block(MD_CTX* ctx, const MD_LINE_ANALYSIS* line)
{
    MD_BLOCK* block;', 'static int
md_start_new_block(MD_CTX* ctx, const MD_LINE_ANALYSIS* line)
{
    if(line->type >= 9) bad_start_hook(line->type);
    MD_BLOCK* block;')
Path('/tmp/md4c_tablehook.c').write_text(s)
PY
